deploybot: commands: `git fetch && git checkout tags/release-2026-03-19 (4f7e3ad)` · k8s rollout: `kubectl set image svc/inference inference=redwood/inference:release-2026-03-19`

eva: starting monitoring, will watch p50/p95, 5xx, and model mismatch alerts.

nate: watching GPU mem and tail latencies in us-west-2. will ping if anything >10% change.

ops-bot: canary 5% traffic injected at 1777777810 — smoke checks running (latency, errors, token cost).

samir: quick note — saw an increased tokenization CPU sample on one replica at +18% but no errors yet. may be noisy from warmups.

eva: hold on ramping to 50% for 8m to verify the CPU trend, if it stabilizes proceed. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: canary 5% checks OK after 5m — p50/p95 within SLO, 5xx unchanged, cache hit stable. request to proceed to 50%? :thumbsup:

eva: agreed — proceed after one more minute.

deploybot: shifting traffic to 50% at 1777777894 — routing policy=latency-first, fallback=prev-variant.

ops-bot: at 1777777920 alert: 5xx spike in us-west-2-a (instance inf-023). error-rate up 1.8% above baseline, individual host showing timeouts to KV cache. auto-fallback engaged for that AZ.

samir: investigating KV timeouts — noticing elevated connection resets from inf-023 to cache-proxy-7. logs attached: `ERR conn_reset` repeated.

eva: hold rollout. pinning traffic away from that AZ and rolling back that node. samir can you try a graceful restart of cache-proxy-7?

samir: restarting cache-proxy-7 now (`systemctl restart cache-proxy`) — checking connections.

ops-bot: traffic rebalanced — 50% still on new tag but AZ us-west-2-a reduced to 0% for new variant at 1777777958.

nate: tail latencies normalized after rebalancing. GPU usage steady.

eva: decision: do not roll forward to 100% yet. we'll pin production in this region to previous stable variant for now and continue investigation. create a follow-up PR to revert config on the affected release.

deploybot: action taken · region=us-west-2-a pinned to prev-variant commit=9b2a1c · global traffic remains 50% on release-2026-03-19.

samir: cache-proxy-7 logs show a flaky NIC driver event. filing infra ticket and scheduling a node reprovision. ticket #INF-4382.

eva: thanks. can we get a short note for release notes and for on-call handoff? include tag, pinned-commit, region affected, and next steps.

deploybot: PROD deploy paused (partial pin applied) · summary: tag=release-2026-03-19, commit=4f7e3ad, pinned-region=us-west-2-a->commit=9b2a1c, canary=50% global — timestamp=1777777989.

ops-bot: after pin, 20m of additional checks show stable p95 and error rates back to baseline.

eva: given stabilization, we'll resume slow ramp in 30m after infra reprovision. Will post update before resuming.

deploybot: RESUME scheduled at 1777779560 (T+30m) if no regressions.
